name: Johannes Käfer
headline: Head of Project Management @ ITZBund
summary:
With over 15 years of experience in software development, consulting and leading teams of varying sizes, I am currently Head of Project Management at ITZBund, the central IT service provider for the Federal Government of Germany. I guide a team of around 70 project managers and assistants, who manage around 200 projects for various customers using agile or VMXT methodologies.

My core competencies include agile methods, software development, enterprise architecutre, team management, business administration and human resource management. I have successfully delivered large-scale projects, such as the Verwaltungsportal Bund and the Nutzerkonto Bund, that enhance the digital services and user experience for the citizens and businesses. My mission is to leverage my technical know how in combination with my desire to transform the way we deliver software within the government to provide innovative, efficient, and secure IT solutions for the public sector.

positions.title: Head of Project Management
positions.description:
The Project Management department (Referat) within ITZBund is responsible for managing primarily software and infrastructure projects. With a team of 70 colleagues, mainly project managers and assistants, we manage around 200 projects for customers within the Federal Government using either the VMXT or Agile project management methodologies.

As head my primary tasks involve:
 * Human Resource Management, including job postings, conducting job interviews, performance evaluations, and regular check-ins with colleagues.
  * Resource Management to optimize available resources and prevent bottlenecks while keeping track of workloads.
  * Escalation Management within ITZBund and the Federal Government in case of obstacles within the projects
  * Transitioning from traditional tools such as Outlook, Word, and Excel to more efficient tools like JIRA and Confluence for increased transparency and collaboration. 
  * Defining yearly SMART goals and KPIs to measure success rates and improvements.
  * Promoting the adoption of new technologies such as Low Code Platforms, digital wallets, integrated enterprise architecture and more.

And as an experienced IT project manager, I offer my colleagues advice and guidance in project management.

company.name: ITZBund
company.tagline: Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft des Landes. #DigitalfürDeutschland
company.description:
Die Bundesregierung hat eine umfassende Konsolidierung der IT des Bundes beschlossen.

Zur Neuaufstellung der IT des Bundes sind weitreichende organisatorische und technische Maßnahmen notwendig. Der Bund wird seine Kräfte in der IT bündeln und dazu den IT-Betrieb der unmittelbaren Bundesverwaltung bis 2022 stufenweise in ein bis zwei IT-Dienstleistern an wenigen Standorten konzentrieren (Betriebskonsolidierung), die Entwicklung von häufig im Bund benötigten IT-Anwendungen und -Diensten zusammenfassen und eine Bundescloud aufbauen (Anwendungskonsolidierung) und die IT-Beschaffung in wenigen Stellen der Bundesverwaltung zusammenführen (Beschaffungsbündelung). Mit der Umsetzung der IT-Konsolidierung Bund wird ein ressortübergreifendes, aus zunächst sechs Teilprojekten bestehendes Projekt eingerichtet. Das gesamte Projekt wird von dem Bundesbeauftragten für IT (BfIT) im Bundesministerium des Innern geleitet.
